description: Modifies an image from a prompt, faster and cheaper than Photon-1 (Photon-Flash-1 Modify).

prompt.description: Prompt for the image modification. node.py widget default is the empty string; node.py does not call `validate_string` here.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

image_weight.description: Weight of the image (0.0-0.98, default 0.1). The closer to 1.0, the less the image will be modified. Body assembly translates to `1.0 - image_weight` clamped+rounded per node.py:354.
